items.title: Why I’d Pick Economy Over Premium Economy On An Overnight Flight
items.why: Cabin label matters less than seat design for sleep, so premium travel perks should sell comfort specifics, not cabin names.
items.summary_ai: A flyer found empty economy seats more restful than premium economy on an overnight Air France flight, due to fixed armrests.
items.take: Cabin label matters less than seat design for sleep, so premium travel perks should sell comfort specifics, not cabin names.
